description: MUTATES Quaderno data — create a contact (customer or vendor). Provide kind plus a name; use `fields` for any other Quaderno contact attribute (phone_1, region, postal_code, city, street_line_1/2, tax_status, language, discount, notes, processor/processor_id). Quaderno API: POST /contacts. Returns the created contact.

contact_name.description: The contact person's name at a company (companies only).

fields.description: Additional raw Quaderno fields merged into the request body (escape hatch for any field not typed above).

first_name.description: For a person: their first name. For a company: the company name (Quaderno stores it here).

tax_id.description: The contact's tax ID / VAT number.

name: create_contact
title: Create a contact
